meta.name: content-engagement
meta.description: Content engagement signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about content engagement signals, LinkedIn post likes/comments, webinar attendance, newsletter engagement, Trigify setup, social engagement tracking, or community engagement signals. Do NOT use for website visitor tracking (use website-visitors skill) or competitor content engagement (use competitor-signals skill).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪B2B外联中的内容互动信号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需监控LinkedIn互动、网络研讨会参与等B2B线索信号。
copy.tagline_en: Track content engagement signals for B2B outbound.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor LinkedIn interactions, webinar attendance, and other B2B prospect signals.

howto.what: Claude会追踪和分析内容参与信号（如LinkedIn点赞/评论、网络研讨会出席、邮件互动），识别高意向潜在客户，并指导如何通过ColdIQ或Trigify获取数据。
howto.when: 当你询问内容参与信号、LinkedIn帖子互动、网络研讨会出席、新闻简报互动、Trigify设置或社区参与信号时触发。

say.text: 帮我追踪这条LinkedIn帖子的点赞和评论。
查看上周网络研讨会的出席者信息。
say.note: Claude会识别25分信号的潜在客户。

say.text: 找出在LinkedIn上关注我们公司的人。
say.note: Claude会过滤出ICP匹配的联系人。

howto.what_en: Claude tracks and analyzes content engagement signals (e.g., LinkedIn likes/comments, webinar attendance, email clicks) to identify warm prospects and guides using ColdIQ or Trigify to retrieve data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about content engagement signals, LinkedIn post interactions, webinar attendance, newsletter engagement, Trigify setup, or community engagement signals.

say_en.text: Track likes and comments on this LinkedIn post.
say_en.note: Claude will use ColdIQ or suggest Trigify to fetch engagers.

say_en.text: Show attendees from last week's webinar.
Find people who followed our company on LinkedIn.
say_en.note: Claude filters ICP-matched contacts for follow-up.
